translations.u064: Fleequid is a professional operator active in the management of large fleets with qualified expertise in the sector of company vehicle recovery, including through withdrawal, evaluation, disposal and sale. Fleequid is, among other things, a provider of information society services, as defined by Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 of 19 October 2022, by Directive 2000/31/EC and by Art. 1(1)(b) of Directive (EU) 2015/1535, having designed, developed and launched an online marketplace (Marketplace) where Users can buy and sell Vehicles as well as request and use the other Services. The Marketplace operates in particular as an auction platform, giving Sellers the opportunity to advertise the availability of Vehicles for sale and Bidders the opportunity to make Bids, including by way of raised bids, and also allows the further Sales Event methods provided for in Art. 9 to be conducted. Fleequid may also, including in the context of transactions organised or managed through the Marketplace, purchase Vehicles in its own name and on its own behalf and resell them under the Dealer Sales Model.
translations.u065: These General Terms and Conditions are intended to regulate the methods and conditions under which Users can join and use the Marketplace, grant Fleequid the mandate to market their Vehicles by means of the Offer to Sell, grant Fleequid mandates relating to the purchase or sale of Vehicles, sell Vehicles to Fleequid or purchase them from it, conclude Sales Contracts, access the Financing Solutions made available or indicated by Fleequid, or request and obtain additional Services.
translations.u066: For the purposes of these General Terms and Conditions, sales transactions are structured exclusively in accordance with one of the following two Sales Models:
translations.u067: Commission Sale, in which Fleequid, under an irrevocable mandate from the Users, arranges on their behalf the sale and purchase of the Vehicle, performing the transaction, alternatively, by means of Resale or acting as a Pure Intermediary;
translations.u068: Dealer Sales, in which Fleequid purchases the Vehicle from the Seller in its own name and on its own behalf and resells it, again in its own name and on its own behalf, to the Buyer.
translations.u069: In the context of the Commission Sale, the transaction may be performed, alternatively, by means of Resale or with Fleequid acting as a Pure Intermediary, in accordance with Arts. 2.5, 2.6 and 17 below. The Resale and operation as a Pure Intermediary constitute alternative methods of performance of the Commission Sale and not separate Sales Models.
translations.u070: Where the specific transaction is classified as a Commission Sale pursuant to Art. 3, Users acknowledge and accept that the relevant Sales Event is organised and managed by Fleequid under an irrevocable mandate from the Users and on their behalf. In such cases, and with reference to the specific transaction, the User who operates on the Marketplace as a Seller, having submitted an Offer to Sell to Fleequid, grants Fleequid, which accepts, the irrevocable mandate to sell on that User's behalf the Vehicles indicated from time to time, at the Sale Price to the Buyer, determined, as the case may be, as corresponding to: a. the value of the Highest Bid when it is equal to or higher than the Reserve Price, always previously determined on the basis of the MCSP indicated by the Seller; b. the Highest Bid lower than such RP, but expressly accepted by the Seller pursuant to Art. 10.3; c. the value of the counter-offer made by the Seller to the Bidder and accepted by the latter; or d. the price resulting from the further Sales Event methods provided for in Art. 9.4. The User who operates on the Marketplace as a Bidder in turn grants Fleequid, which accepts, the irrevocable mandate to arrange on that User's behalf the purchase of one or more Vehicles at the Sale Price to the Buyer resulting from the Sales Event. The classification of the mandate provided for in this paragraph as a commission mandate pursuant to Art. 1731 of the Italian Civil Code, with Fleequid consequently acting in its own name, applies exclusively where the transaction is performed by means of Resale pursuant to Art. 2.5 below; where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the sale is concluded directly between the Seller and the Buyer pursuant to Art. 2.6 below. In both methods of performance, Fleequid is owed the Commissions payable by the Seller and by the Buyer and the Fees for any Services rendered, in accordance with Art. 17.2. The Offer to Sell does not, in itself, entail the granting of a commission mandate pursuant to Art. 1731 of the Italian Civil Code, which arises exclusively in cases where Fleequid acts as a commission agent in the specific transaction.
translations.u071: Where Fleequid performs the Commission Sale by means of Resale, Users acknowledge and accept that Fleequid acts in its own name and on behalf of the Users, as a commission agent for both the Bidder and the Seller, with an irrevocable mandate to buy and to sell, respectively, pursuant to Arts. 1703 et seq. and 1731 of the Italian Civil Code, and is entitled to the Commissions due from both on the terms provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. In this method of performance, the Seller commissions Fleequid, which accepts, pursuant to Art. 1731 of the Italian Civil Code, to sell, in its own name and on behalf of the Seller, the Vehicles indicated from time to time, at the Sale Price to the Buyer determined in accordance with Art. 2.4, while the Bidder grants Fleequid, which accepts, an irrevocable commission mandate to purchase, on the Bidder's behalf but in the name of Fleequid, one or more Vehicles at the same price. Once the Binding Agreement has been concluded and where the conditions provided for in Arts. 8.8 and 12 are met, Fleequid transfers the Vehicle and attributes the commissioned sale to its principals by means of the Resale, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 2.6 below. The Parties acknowledge that the Resale is carried out by Fleequid for the sole purpose of attributing the sales contract to the respective principals, i.e. the Seller and the Buyer. In order to complete the Resale, Fleequid purchases the Vehicle from the Seller and transfers ownership thereof to the Buyer (sale with obligatory effects pursuant to Art. 1478 of the Italian Civil Code). Therefore, in accordance with the terms and conditions set out in these General Terms and Conditions, any Specific Terms and Conditions, any Special Sale Terms and Conditions or any other applicable contractual agreements, the Seller is required to transfer ownership of the Vehicle to Fleequid and the Buyer is required to purchase the same Vehicle from Fleequid, in accordance with the terms resulting from the Binding Agreement. In respect of the Resale only, Users expressly authorise Fleequid to enter into sales contracts pursuant to Art. 1395 of the Italian Civil Code and acknowledge and accept that Fleequid is not involved in determining the financial content of the sales contract entered into from time to time, since the MCSP for each Vehicle is set exclusively by the Seller, while, where provided for the specific type of Sales Event, the Reserve Price is consequently determined by Fleequid on the basis of the MCSP and the Commissions contractually charged to the Seller applicable to the specific transaction, to ensure that the Seller, upon the Reserve Price being reached, receives net proceeds at least equal to the MCSP; the Sale Price to the Buyer is formed in the Auction competition, by making the Bids and any possible raised bids, or in accordance with the further Sales Event method applicable pursuant to Art. 9.4. In light of the foregoing, the Parties expressly acknowledge and accept that the Marketplace's specific operating procedures and the related sales process represent adequate and sufficient conditions, similar to those indicated in Art. 1515(3) of the Italian Civil Code, for the autonomous and independent determination of the essential contents of the sales contract, excluding any conflict of interest on the part of Fleequid. The provisions of Art. 9.4, letter d), remain unaffected with regard to 1 Euro Auctions and the relevant Special Sale Terms and Conditions.
translations.u072: In the context of the Commission Sale, Fleequid may, at its sole discretion, decide not to carry out the Resale and to perform the commissioned sale as a Pure Intermediary, allowing the transfer of the Vehicle and the related invoicing to take place directly from the Seller to the Buyer. In such case the sale of the Vehicle is concluded directly between the Seller and the Buyer; Fleequid does not conclude it, either in its own name or as a party, does not purchase the Vehicle, not even temporarily, does not take on the role of seller, not even of formal seller, and the price of the Vehicle is paid by the Buyer directly to the Seller; Fleequid retains the right to the Commissions due from both Parties and to the Fees in accordance with these General Terms and Conditions. Operation as a Pure Intermediary constitutes an internal method of performance of the Commission Sale pursuant to Art. 2.3 and not a separate Sales Model. The right of choice provided for in this paragraph is exercised in accordance with Arts. 3.2, 3.5 and 17.1, is made known in advance pursuant to Art. 3.2, letter a) and is accepted by adhering to these GTC.
translations.u073: In the Dealer Sales Model, Fleequid purchases the Vehicle from the Seller in its own name and on its own behalf and resells it to the Buyer, again in its own name and on its own behalf, taking on the role of substantial party to both contracts, as buyer in the first and as seller in the second, respectively. The two sale relationships are separate and independent. In this Sales Model Fleequid does not act as mandatary or commission agent of the Seller or of the Buyer and the Commissions specific to the Commission Sale are not due; any difference between the Purchase Price and the Sale Price to the Buyer constitutes the financial result of the purchase and sale activity carried out by Fleequid and not a Commission. The relationships of purchase and subsequent resale are governed by Art. 18 and by the further applicable provisions.
translations.u074: None of the Sales Models characterises Fleequid's activity generally and exclusively. The provisions of these General Terms and Conditions based on a specific Sales Model apply exclusively to transactions classified as such pursuant to Art. 3. The fact that the transaction is organised or operationally managed through the Marketplace does not turn Dealer Sales into an activity of mere intermediation; conversely, the role of substantial seller taken on by Fleequid in Dealer Sales does not extend to the other Sales Models or to the methods of performance of the Commission Sale.
translations.u075: The transactions governed by these General Terms and Conditions may be carried out not only by Adorea S.r.l. but also by other legal entities affiliated with or designated by it for the sale and purchase of Vehicles. Users agree that such operating structure may include, by way of example, branches, affiliates, or other companies formally incorporated and attributable to Fleequid, including those located in foreign countries, and that sales are governed by the tax legislation applicable in the country in which the legal entity involved in the specific transaction is based. If a sale is made through a legal entity other than Adorea S.r.l., Fleequid communicates to Users, in the relevant contractual and tax documents, the identification details of the entity involved; these details may be made known in advance, by communicating them to the Seller upon acceptance of the Offer to Sell and to the Bidder in the Listing, or, where Fleequid does not take on the role of seller, buyer or contractual counterparty in the specific transaction, at the latest with the Proforma, on which the applicable VAT regime and the payment details depend. This paragraph does not affect the identification of the Sales Model pursuant to Art. 3.
translations.u077: Users acknowledge and accept that the Sales Model applicable to the individual transaction is identified by Fleequid in the context of the organisation and management of the process of marketing the Vehicle. That choice is made in any event before the Bidder is able to make a Bid. Unless otherwise agreed in an Individual Contract, the determination of the Sales Model rests exclusively with Fleequid.
translations.u078: The Sales Model identified pursuant to the preceding paragraph is made known to the Bidder before the Bid is made. To that end, the Listing indicates the applicable Sales Model, including by means of a specific designation, badge, label, icon, wording or other graphic or textual element capable of identifying it clearly and unambiguously. Where the specific transaction does not involve the publication of a Listing, the Sales Model is indicated in the communication by which Fleequid enables the Bidder to make a Bid. In any event, Fleequid always makes known to the Bidder at least:
translations.u079: the applicable Sales Model and, consequently, the capacity in which Fleequid acts in the specific transaction, specifying whether it acts under a mandate from the Users in the context of the Commission Sale or as buyer and subsequent seller on its own account in Dealer Sales; in the Commission Sale it is also made known that the transaction may be performed, alternatively, by means of Resale, in which Fleequid acts as a commission agent in its own name pursuant to Art. 2.5, or with Fleequid acting as a Pure Intermediary, with the sale concluded directly between the Seller and the Buyer pursuant to Art. 2.6, and that the method actually chosen is crystallised in the Proforma pursuant to Art. 17.1;
translations.u080: the Commissions, the Fees and any further amounts charged to the Bidder under the Fleequid Fee Schedule, the Special Sale Terms and Conditions or the other conditions applicable to the specific transaction;
translations.u081: any obligation to pay the Security Deposit and the relevant amount, in accordance with Art. 6;
translations.u082: any availability of Financing Solutions and, where provided for by the relevant rules, the possibility that the Financier may acquire the status of Buyer.
translations.u083: The indications relating to the Sales Model, to the alternative methods of performance in the Commission Sale and to the amounts charged to the Bidder pursuant to Art. 3.2, letters a), b) and c) above, are binding on Fleequid in the specific transaction and are not subject to the merely indicative nature provided for in Art. 9.3. It remains understood that any availability of the Financing Solutions is subject to the conditions provided for by the relevant rules.
translations.u084: The disclosure of the Sales Model does not require a specific separate declaration or the use of a particular formal method, provided that the Model applicable to the specific transaction is clearly identifiable by the Bidder before the Bid is made. Any omission of a specific designation, badge, label, icon or wording does not prejudice the identification of the Model where it is in any event clearly recognisable from the information made available to the Bidder taken as a whole.
translations.u085: Until a Bid is made, Fleequid may change the Sales Model applicable to the specific transaction, it being understood that, before Bids can be made under the new Model, the latter and the relevant conditions are made known to the Seller pursuant to Art. 3.7 and to the Bidders pursuant to Art. 3.2. After a Bid has been made, the Sales Model applicable to the relevant transaction may not be changed unilaterally by Fleequid, either in its relationship with the Seller or vis-à-vis the Bidder. Fleequid's right to adopt a different Sales Model in the context of a subsequent transaction or of a new Sales Event relating to the same Vehicle, in accordance with Arts. 8.6 and 8.8, remains unaffected. In the context of the Commission Sale, Fleequid's choice whether or not to carry out the Resale pursuant to Art. 2.6 does not constitute a change of the Sales Model and is governed by Art. 17.1.
translations.u086: The Sales Model applicable to each transaction is the one identified by Fleequid and made known in accordance with the preceding paragraphs; no Sales Model is deemed applicable automatically or on a residual basis. Any discrepancies, inaccuracies or omissions contained in individual communications or documents relating to the transaction do not, in themselves, result in a change of the Sales Model identified for the specific transaction.
translations.u087: The Sales Model applicable to the specific transaction is also made known to the Seller, together with the financial terms concerning the Seller, before the transaction is opened to the making of Bids. To that end, such information may be apparent from the Listing or from the information relating to the Vehicle or to the Sales Event available on the Marketplace, including by means of a specific designation, badge, label, icon, wording or other graphic or textual element capable of identifying it clearly, or may be made available by e-mail or through the other channels normally used in dealings with the Seller. No separate or independent communication is required, provided that the relevant information is made known to the Seller by one of the methods indicated above. In particular, the following are made known to the Seller:
translations.u088: in the Commission Sale, the application of that Sales Model, the Commissions and the Fees charged to the Seller, as well as the MCSP and the related financial mechanism, in accordance with the Fleequid Fee Schedule and the further conditions applicable to the specific transaction, as well as the fact that the transaction may be performed by means of Resale or with Fleequid acting as a Pure Intermediary;
translations.u089: in Dealer Sales, the application of that Sales Model and the fact that Fleequid purchases the Vehicle on its own account from the Seller, without application of the Commissions provided for the Commission Sale, at the Purchase Price or in accordance with the financial criterion, already accepted by the Seller, by which it can be determined, and the further conditions agreed with the Seller.
translations.u090: The disclosure of the financial elements provided for in the preceding paragraphs concerns their determination; the conditions for their accrual, their falling due and their payment, where applicable, remain governed by the further provisions of these GTC and, in particular, by Art. 12.4.
translations.u092: By registering or simply using the Marketplace, Users explicitly accept these General Terms and Conditions as well as any applicable Specific Terms and Conditions and Special Sale Terms and Conditions and undertake to abide by them. Such conditions apply even where they are not set out in full in the individual Listings, provided that they are made applicable and known in accordance with these General Terms and Conditions. Unless otherwise expressly agreed in writing by Fleequid, the relationships governed by these General Terms and Conditions are regulated exclusively by the contractual sources prepared by Fleequid in accordance with the hierarchy set out in Art. 4.3. Any general or special terms and conditions of contract, of supply, of purchase or of any other nature prepared or proposed by Users are not considered accepted by Fleequid, even where referred to in orders, confirmations, correspondence or other documents of the User. They are valid and binding on Fleequid only where expressly approved in writing by Fleequid after the acceptance of these General Terms and Conditions, with a clear and specific indication of the intention to derogate from them, in whole or in part.
translations.u093: Fleequid reserves the right to modify unilaterally the General Terms and Conditions and the Fleequid Fee Schedule at its discretion at any time, including in order to introduce new products or Services, to adapt the operating procedures of the Marketplace or to comply with legal or regulatory provisions or with measures of the competent authorities. Changes shall be notified to Users in a clear and understandable manner at least 30 (thirty) calendar days before they come into effect, unless the User has expressly accepted them before the end of this period. Fleequid keeps an archive of previous versions of the General Terms and Conditions and of the Fleequid Fee Schedule, which can be accessed by contacting customer support. Changes may be communicated using one or more of the following tools: a) e-mail to the e-mail address associated with the User's profile, containing a summary of the changes and a link to the updated texts; b) notification displayed when the User next logs in to the Marketplace; c) publication of a notice on the homepage of the Fleequid website, with a link to the updated texts. A User who does not intend to accept the changes may withdraw without incurring penalties within 30 (thirty) calendar days of the communication and in any case of the publication of the updated General Terms and Conditions on the Marketplace, by written communication to the e-mail address withdrawal@fleequid.com. The changes apply to the Sales Events and transactions commenced after their entry into effect; the Sales Events and transactions already in progress, as well as those for which the Binding Agreement has already been concluded, shall continue to be governed until their completion by the General Terms and Conditions and the Fleequid Fee Schedule in force at the time the relevant Event or transaction commenced, save as provided for in Art. 4.9. Upon receipt of the withdrawal notice, Fleequid shall delete the User's profile in accordance with Art. 5.11. Users are required to check the version of the General Terms and Conditions and of the Fleequid Fee Schedule in force before making a Bid, by consulting the appropriate section of the Marketplace. Once the notice period has elapsed, continued use of the Marketplace or of Fleequid's Services entails acceptance of the changes that have come into effect. In the event of a dispute regarding the version or applicability of the General Terms and Conditions to the Contract, Users must demonstrate that, despite all reasonable efforts, they have been unable to view the applicable General Terms and Conditions despite consulting the appropriate section of the Marketplace and making a timely written request to Fleequid, before raising any objection, question or complaint in this regard.
translations.u094: The Specific Terms and Conditions, the Special Sale Terms and Conditions and any Individual Contracts may supplement or govern, including in derogation of these General Terms and Conditions, the relationship between Fleequid and certain Users, or between Users themselves, with regard to one or more Vehicles, Sales Events or Services. Where several contractual sources are applicable to the same transaction or to the same relationship, Users acknowledge, in the event of conflict, the following order of priority: 1) Individual Contract, provided that it is formalised in writing and approved by Fleequid, in respect of the matters it expressly governs or derogates from and solely as regards the relationships with the Users that are parties to it; 2) Specific Terms and Conditions, for the special, standardised and recurring rules applicable to particular Services, products, categories of Vehicles or matters, such as, by way of example but not limited to, Fleequid Care, the Financing Solutions and the further Services or commercial programmes for which Fleequid provides dedicated contractual rules; 3) Special Sale Terms and Conditions, for the parameters, conditions and express derogations of the individual transaction or the individual Sales Event, such as, by way of example but not limited to, the conditions applicable to 1 Euro Auctions, the special conditions relating to the transactions referred to in Art. 13, as well as any special conditions relating to the sales methods, the participation requirements, the determination of the price, the Commissions, the Fees, the warranties specifically provided for the transaction, or delivery; 4) General Terms and Conditions, on a general and residual basis.
translations.u095: The order of priority provided for in Art. 4.3 operates exclusively in the event of conflict between contractual sources governing the same matter. Each source prevails only in respect of the matters it governs; in the absence of incompatibility, the sources supplement one another. The Special Sale Terms and Conditions may derogate from the Specific Terms and Conditions only in a manner that is express, clear and referable to the specific matter or provision derogated from; failing such express derogation, the Specific Terms and Conditions prevail in respect of the matters they govern. In particular, the Specific Terms and Conditions relating to the Financing Solutions may lay down special rules on payment, invoicing, registration, transfer of ownership, availability and delivery of the Vehicle, in accordance with Art. 22.
translations.u096: The Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction or to the individual Sales Event may be set out directly in the Listing, referred to by means of a link or reference to a document or to a dedicated section of the Marketplace, or identified by means of badges, labels, wording or other graphic or textual elements capable of making their application clearly recognisable. Where the relevant text is made accessible and available for consultation before the Bid is made, such Special Sale Terms and Conditions apply to the transaction and are binding on Users without the need for separate acceptance.
translations.u097: The Listing serves the dual function of describing the Vehicle and the characteristics of the specific transaction and of containing, identifying or referring to any applicable Special Sale Terms and Conditions. Not all the information contained or referred to in the Listing therefore constitutes Special Sale Terms and Conditions: the descriptive data of the Vehicle, the images, the mileage, the TrustReport, the Technical Specifications and the further information relating to the Vehicle retain their own function. The provisions intended to govern the specific transaction or the relevant Sales Event and made recognisable as such in the manner provided for in Art. 4.5 constitute Special Sale Terms and Conditions.
translations.u098: The Proforma, the invoices and the communications relating to the performance phase of the transaction do not constitute independent contractual sources and may not unilaterally modify the contractual conditions applicable to the specific transaction or introduce new obligations. The amount indicated in the Proforma constitutes the Total Amount Due from the Buyer, save for manifest clerical error. The invoices issued in relation to the transaction document, depending on the applicable Sales Model and the manner in which the sale is performed, the respective financial and tax relationships, without modifying, in themselves, the total amount owed by the Buyer. The making available of the Proforma causes the Payment Period to start running in accordance with Art. 11, without the Proforma thereby acquiring the nature of a contractual source.
translations.u099: Until Bids have been made, Fleequid may modify the conditions applicable to the specific transaction or to the individual Sales Event, making known the applicable version in accordance with Arts. 3.2, 3.7, 4.5 and 9.2. Where Bids have already been made, a substantial modification of the applicable conditions does not apply to the Bids already made: Fleequid, where it intends to apply the modification, neutralises the Bids concerned, makes known the new version of the conditions and allows Users to make a new declaration of intent. Purely clerical or formal corrections, having no financial or legal impact, may be made without the need to neutralise the Bids already made. Once the Binding Agreement has been concluded, no unilateral modification of the applicable conditions is permitted, save for the express agreement of the Parties concerned, mechanisms already agreed and made known in advance or mandatory adjustments pursuant to Art. 4.9. The provisions of Art. 9.7 on manifest clerical error remain unaffected.
translations.u100: Changes to these General Terms and Conditions, to the Fleequid Fee Schedule or to the further applicable conditions that are required by a law, a regulation or a binding measure of the competent authority apply from the date and to the extent required by the higher-ranking source, including to ongoing relationships where necessary, without this giving rise to any generalised contractual retroactivity. Effects that have already definitively accrued remain unaffected, unless otherwise provided by mandatory provisions. In the same cases Fleequid may adapt the operating procedures of the Marketplace and of the transactions, require further documents and formalities from Users, suspend performance, prevent activities that are no longer permitted and proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale pursuant to Art. 14 where the continuation of the transaction is unlawful or incompatible with the supervening legislation.

new_terms.why: Coerente con k01 (u028 'make known the elements', u034 'made known in advance'); il sostantivo 'conoscibilità' resta 'disclosure' come nel titolo dell'art. 3.
Come in k01 (u046 'commission mandates'), per non confonderla con 'Commissions' (corrispettivi).
Coerente con 'mandate' usato in tutta la v8 EN per mandato/incarico; distinto da 'commission agent'.
Resa standard; distinta da 'in nome e per conto proprio' = 'in its own name and on its own behalf' (k01).

new_terms.it: condizioni economiche / elementi economici / meccanismo economico / criterio economico
new_terms.tr: financial terms / financial elements / financial mechanism / financial criterion
new_terms.why: Scelta del revisore k01: 'economico' riferito all'operazione = 'financial'.
Titolo art. 4 già fissato; 'fonte negoziale' reso allo stesso modo (k01 u043 'is not a contractual source').
Termine nuovo; resa letterale, l'IT stesso usa un termine tecnico non codicistico.
Resa standard nella gerarchia delle fonti.
Nell'IT v9 (artt. 15, 16) 'intestazione/reintestazione' è la registrazione del Veicolo a nome dell'avente diritto.
v8 EN 3.2 ('User's Marketplace profile'); 'account' sostituito da 'profile' perché l'IT passa da 'account' a 'profilo'.

notes: u064: corretto il refuso della v8 EN 'Directive 2000/31/C' in '2000/31/EC'.
u064, u073: 'Modello di Vendita Dealer Sales' reso 'Dealer Sales Model' (scelta del revisore, al posto di 'Dealer Sales Sales Model'): da usare ovunque nel documento.
u071: 'vendita obbligatoria ai sensi dell'art. 1478 c.c.' reso 'sale with obligatory effects' (revisore: corretto l'errore evidente della v8 'mandatory sale'); da far validare allo studio.

u071: 'terzo comma dell'art. 1515 c.c.' mantenuto come nella v8 'Article 1515(3)'; 'rilanci' mantenuto 'raises' come nella v8 2.4, mentre in u064 'anche mediante rilanci' = 'including by way of raised bids' (k01 u011).
u070: le lettere a., b., c., d. non sono in corsivo nell'IT v9 (lo erano nella v8): nessun tag.

u075: ripresa la resa v8 della definizione di Fleequid (da cui il testo è stato spostato) per le frasi invariate ('branches, affiliates, or other companies formally incorporated and attributable to Fleequid', 'is based').
u093: e-mail withdrawal@fleequid.com senza grassetto/sottolineato perché l'IT v9 non li ha (la v8 EN li aveva).
review: u064, u073: Dealer Sales Sales Model → Dealer Sales Model — elimina la ripetizione 'Sales Sales' (sembra un refuso); la forma contiene per intero sia 'Dealer Sales' sia 'Sales Model' e l'IT stesso abbrevia il termine in 'Modello' (artt. 3.4, 3.5). Da applicare a tutto il documento.

u071: mandatory sale → sale with obligatory effects — errore evidente della v8: la 'vendita obbligatoria' ex art. 1478 c.c. è una vendita a effetti obbligatori (cosa altrui), non una vendita imposta; 'mandatory sale' cambia il senso giuridico. Termine non definito, unica occorrenza nel documento.

u070: always determined in advance → always previously determined — ripristinato l'avverbio della resa v8 ('always previously indicated'): l'IT cambia solo 'indicato' in 'determinato sulla base del PMIV'.
u072: even temporarily / even of formal seller → not even temporarily / not even of formal seller — 'neppure' dopo una negazione è 'not even'; 'even' da solo rende la frase ambigua.
u074: built on a specific Sales Model → based on — calco di 'costruite su'.
u086: shall be deemed → is deemed — coerenza con il presente indicativo usato nel resto dell'art. 3 (testo nuovo).
u094: the warranties specifically provided for the transaction or delivery → ..., or delivery — 'alla consegna' è una materia autonoma dell'elenco, non un complemento di 'garanzie previste per'.
